hi_additional: No registration, advertising or analytics transmission. Recipes and kitchen data stay on this device. English photo recognition runs on device. Website import contacts the requested site and redirects. Voice is push-to-talk; your speech provider may process audio online. DishNest stores no raw audio. When configured, billing sends Amazon user and receipt identifiers to the verification service and Amazon; signed receipts are stored privately for restore and offline access. Cloud backup is not connected.

Subscriptions renew through Amazon until cancelled in your Amazon subscription settings. Amazon shows the applicable price, billing period and any offer before you confirm. A lifetime purchase is a single payment. No trial is promised by DishNest.
